title: Public Health Alliance for Genomic Epidemiology (PHA4GE) – Website
organization: Public Health Alliance for Genomic Epidemiology (PHA4GE)
description: PHA4GE is a global partnership advancing open, reproducible, and accessible genomics and bioinformatics for public health, developing shared standards, guidance, and best practices to strengthen surveillance and outbreak response. ([pha4ge.org](https://pha4ge.org/))
keyFeatures: Open standards and guidance for public health bioinformatics and genomic epidemiology.
Working groups on data structures, pipelines/visualization, ethics & data sharing, training, and repositories.
Driver projects applying standards across priority areas (e.g., AMR, wastewater, mpox, cholera).
Links to training portal and recurring webinar series.
practicalUse: Use this portal to adopt PHA4GE standards, access implementation guidance and tools, and engage with a global community of practice.
formatDetails: Organizational web portal linking to standards, guidance documents, working groups, projects, and training resources.
legacyTags: Summary based on the PHA4GE homepage
